Read the three files src/a.rs, src/b.rs and src/c.rs concurrently so they can be compared afterwards.
Find all markdown files matching docs/*.md, then read every file that was found, collecting the contents.

Read the file VERSION and return the message 'current version: <contents>' with the file contents interpolated into the string.
Read package.json, parse the content as JSON, and return just the version field.
Concurrently get the git status and read CHANGELOG.md, then return an object combining both results under the fields status and changelog.
For each of the paths docs/a.md, docs/b.md and docs/c.md in order, read the file; collect all the contents into one list.
Write the text hello to a file named hello.txt, then read hello.txt back to confirm the content.
Search Cargo.toml for the pattern [package] and assert that at least one match was found, with the failure message 'missing package section'.
In src/main.rs replace the string foo with bar, then run cargo check to verify the crate still compiles.
